summary: Reverified only the two requested theme-diversity estimates against the paper. Read the entire markdown conversion, including all supplementary material and references. PDF p. 10 confirms the Generic AI mean 53.7 and 95% CI [48.2, 59.2], Personalized AI mean 52.3 and 95% CI [46.8, 57.8], and Partially personalized AI mean 56.5 and 95% CI [51.0, 62.1]. These are full-sample campaign-diversity arm summaries; the separately reported quality-tertile effects are excluded subgroups. PDF p. 52 (printed supplement p. 24), Table S2, confirms analyzed arm counts of 116, 114, and 101, respectively; PDF p. 19 establishes that these are the retained participants after exclusions. No separate diversity-analysis exclusions are reported. PDF pp. 5 and 21-23 establish a between-person randomized comparison of AI configurations, with AI available during production of one campaign per participant. PDF p. 23 and PDF p. 40 (printed supplement p. 12) establish campaign-theme embeddings compared with the pooled campaign centroid. The question, construct, measure, unit, timing, AI availability, within-person status, comparison type, and se_basis are correct. The explicit direction on PDF p. 10 supports higher_is = more_diverse. se_basis = participant is supported by the one-campaign-score-per-participant analysis; the unspecified CI method and common-centroid dependence remain documented limitations. The recorded intervals concern arm means, not a treatment difference, and no unprinted contrast statistic or count was inferred. The full-paper completeness review under extraction rules 4-6 found no missing eligible outcome or reported contrast, including no separate full-sample personalized-versus-partially-personalized contrast on final campaign outcomes. No problems found.
